name: GVC-RT V1.3 fixed-decoder code optimization diagnosis
baseline: V1 stage_D same-model ZERO; exact ell_c from V1.2
dtype: float32 D_enh/G, original FP16 base stream and I frame; TF32 disabled
lr_rule: physical continuous-code lr = 0.02 * median RMS of six actual encoder u tensors; quantization-domain lr = physical lr / fixed l3 delta
scale_correction: at most one numerical scale correction on six frames, only if a concrete numerical/domain/gradient issue is found; all attempts retained

A.domain: physical pre-quantizer u; no rounding; residual_scale remains applied
A.selection: minimum recorded MSE+0.001 LPIPS including step0; tie lower step
A.global_initialization: lower six-frame mean selected L_image; exact tie favors ZERO_START
A.extension: only chosen global initialization, fixed optimizer/lr/steps/selection; remaining Train2 24 P and Val6 90 P

B.initialization_rationale: fixed teacher-free coding algorithm; validates zero-input gradient; no initializer search outside six frames
B.domain: dimensionless z; forward s=round(z) with STE; physical decoder input u_hat=s*fixed_delta
B.R_est: frozen V1.2 factorized logistic probability of STE integer symbols, bits divided by 1080*1920; includes no zero-grid skip approximation
B.hard_state_gradient_cache: same sample/lambda and exactly identical rounded symbols permit reuse of the frozen deterministic STE objective gradient; every checkpoint is freshly hard-rendered and coded; first reuse checked against fresh backward (atol1e-7 rtol1e-5)
B.lambda_reference_rule: median over six frames of ||dL_image/dz||_2 / ||dR_est_bpp/dz||_2 at encoder-initialized hard-quantized z; record loss and gradient scales
B.nonzero_selection: retain lowest and highest pressure; choose third from middle candidates whose six-frame projected full-sequence ratio is closest in log space to 25%; projection is calibration only, not an RD result
B.checkpoint_selection: minimum L_image + lambda * R_actual_frame_bpp among recorded steps incl0; tie lower actual bits then lower step
B.R_actual_frame_bpp: actual ORC2 frame packet bits plus (86-byte sequence header + 1-byte I flag)/15, divided by valid pixels; sums exactly to full-sequence file cost
B.snapshot_streams: legal diagnostic 16-frame containers with only current frame nonzero; not formal full-sequence RD points
B.sequence_selection: one feasible whole-sequence lambda candidate with minimum mean L_image; tie fewer actual bits; fixed ZERO no-stream fallback allowed; never mix frames across lambda candidates
B.Val6_gate: exists a budget where both Train2 clips meet actual bytes, aggregate full IP PSNR gain >=0.1dB and aggregate LPIPS worsening <=0.0001
B.existing_encoder_comparator: same budget/whole-sequence selection over existing V1.2 l0-l3 actual streams plus same ZERO no-stream fallback

mismatch: cyclic next video in fixed manifest order, same P index, same branch/domain; decode each stream in own valid context before exchanging
quality: V1 PSNR and five-scale RGB MS-SSIM functions; LPIPS alex v0.1 normalize=True; valid RGB [0,1]
